courses.name: Linear Algebra
courses.description: Covers vector spaces, matrices, determinants, eigenvalues, and linear transformations essential for computer science.

courses.name: التصميم المنطقي
courses.description: Explores Boolean algebra, logic gates, combinational and sequential circuits for digital system design.

courses.name: الرياضيات غير المتصلة
courses.description: Studies sets, graphs, trees, logic, and counting techniques fundamental to algorithms and data structures.

courses.name: برمجة الحاسبات
courses.description: Introduces programming fundamentals including variables, control structures, functions, and problem-solving using code.

courses.name: كتابة التقارير الفنية
courses.description: Develops skills in writing clear, structured technical reports, documentation, and professional communication.

courses.name: مقدمة في نظم المعلومات
courses.description: Provides an overview of information systems, databases, networks, and their role in modern organizations.

courses.name: Operations Research
courses.description: Operations research is the discipline of using mathematical modeling, optimization, and data analysis to make better decisions about how to allocate limited resources, such as scheduling, routing, or production planning, in complex systems.

courses.name: Work Ethics
courses.description: Work ethics in computer science means applying professional integrity to your work: writing honest, secure, and reliable code, respecting user privacy and intellectual property, being accountable for the impact of your systems, and treating colleagues and users fairly.

courses.name: File Processing
courses.description: File processing is the act of reading data from a file, transforming or analyzing it, and writing the results back out (or to another destination), such as opening a document, parsing its contents, and saving a modified version.

courses.name: Statistics & Probabilities
courses.description: Probability uses a known model to predict what data to expect, while statistics uses observed data to figure out the underlying model.

courses.name: Computer Organization & Assembly Language
courses.description: The study of how a computer's hardware is structured and how its parts work together to run programs.

courses.name: Object-Oriented Programming
courses.description: A way of organizing code around objects, which bundle data (attributes) and behavior (methods) together, instead of around standalone functions and logic.

materials.title: Physics Online Quiz 1 (E learning)
materials.notes:
الامتحان الدكتور مده من 10 ل 11 دا الوقت المسموح تدخل فيه الامتحان بس انت ليك 30 دقيقه بس تحل فيهم الامتحان ولو دخلت متأخر 11 الا عشره مثلا هتاخد 10 دقائق بس 


وانت بتحل بتحط الناتج النهائي فقط 
الارقام الكبيره تكتبها ذي ما هيا.  مثلا : 3*10⁶ هتكتبها 3000000
ولو في رقم عشري هتستعمل ال (.) مش ال (,) عشان تتحسبلك يعني هتكتب 8.9 مش 8,9 
ولو في كذا رقم عشري هتاخد اول 3 ارقام بس يعني 
2.46788 انت هتكتب الرقم صحيح و اول 3 ارقام عشري يعني 2.467 بس 

و الاسئله هتحلها في ورقه خارجيه عشان الدكتور ممكن يسالك عليها أو لو السيستم علق ومخدتش الدرجه و اجابتك صح هتاخد ورقة الحل دي وتروح بيها لدكتور
